### The new grant program will lower the cost barrier for small and medium-sized manufacturers working to meet cybersecurity compliance


NORTH BETHESDA, Md., July 27, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) --[Xometry](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=RwbkEUx80StXaCLN92pjkkvSOGZ2zADommtn1WR5fEeaMLAWBosVoHD096Ifv6J3OXsRk8VKgZb5AqV39lRkGw==) , Inc. (NASDAQ: XMTR), the global AI-native marketplace connecting buyers and suppliers of custom manufacturing, announced a new partnership with[MxD, the nation's Digital Manufacturing and Cybersecurity Institute](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=8gKZKeF3lleciTakGUNlyGXPjgBN99EiUmWalU0JN_PBMnix3S09wd12nPKuvocyPoLOBdcHgTkV1ArLinqykI1Y51bb7Q7rYX73QancTuo6efIqPdm8XcDapl_MrX0331jOBu84WE48xutpJCGyUzSlpC5H6tOX3MgOMl-sBeU=) , to help small and medium-sized manufacturers meet cybersecurity compliance. This partnership is the next phase of the[Xometry Foundation](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=RwbkEUx80StXaCLN92pjklquNAz4XW9WLlffikYsLyNyGqa8teKossLX-MkFpwYb7Y21s5-On6uFnpIU1XWQ7zwPQft59dgR7V-hE2jCFSC4vzGsi-V4o9pz5I1oP4T8) , which commits $1 million per year to develop the next generation of engineers and manufacturing talent.


**Closing the Cybersecurity Gap for Small and Mid-Sized Manufacturers in the U.S.**


MxD, the federally designated National Center for Cybersecurity in Manufacturing, equips U.S. factories with the digital tools, cybersecurity protections, and workforce training needed to build a more resilient industrial base. It operates a state-of-the-art factory floor in Chicago and runs MxD Learn, a set of programs that prepare students and professionals alike for in-demand, digitally advanced manufacturing careers.


This partnership and investment with MxD are a part of Xometry’s broader commitment to strengthening the U.S. aerospace and defense industrial base. The grant program is designed to make cybersecurity compliance, including CMMC Level 2, more affordable and accessible for small and medium-sized manufacturers. By lowering the cost of becoming cyber-ready, more businesses can protect their operations, secure valuable government contracts, and create more high-paying job opportunities within their communities.


“Like MxD, Xometry understands that cybersecurity cannot be a luxury reserved for large primes,” said[Berardino Baratta, CEO at MxD](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=uAwOfKVOZtu70WwbmrLWGMGKI-eqZmFmQdLYmwfEQ7hDZ1DeaoIRvFgeOdD7j-VSlU60lNcZvYyA3ZPr4iLDq_il7DfmumF5WLPvCBPaemnXZYstOVwTHWpkhNE2epMmbJ4BDzyprzV4oNd9NGzjxg==) . “Small- and medium-sized manufacturers are the backbone of the defense industrial base, yet they're also the most exposed to cyber threats and the least resourced to defend against them. We are grateful for the partnership with Xometry, which will allow us to close that gap — giving smaller manufacturers access to practical, affordable tools to protect their operations and their place in the supply chain.”


“Too many small and mid-sized manufacturers lack the necessary compliance certifications and credentials they need to compete for defense work,” said[Silpa Gollapalli, SVP of Commercial and leader of the Partner Network at Xometry](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=ja9wHfMEMJEgEY1dueuBq7Vnv6-A38S4YbUzR90q4bMxUbB1ksb8GAqt3yqHhBulDEJU1HPm5yYJ4r1tK5YS53pwUH8QNUL1O5ZmkHcN-_7zSexeFiU659ThJ4VZootfKbjrXaK8_mSJsHcayygX37ggvuue8EyUwvX6n9sFqdJpeAHw1yEa871rVoCOLSJgonwt7qlnMPVvHra_QI7eFA==) . “Through the Xometry Foundation and our partnership with MxD, we're lowering the cost and accessibility barriers, so more manufacturers can meet the highest security standards, win more contracts, and keep growing their business.”


Earlier this year, the Xometry Foundation launched its first initiatives to build the next generation of innovators through partnerships with the[ASME Foundation](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=mSkmtlwlViLw_0fIB1X0EwmtP6x4ixRepbqpNqsVOKE8OtaOZ1Uu1UFvyKkIqIOrdzSNgtu3S045PG46Av7_TQDrapqdFIlLDbveBEY14Y0=) , the[SAE Foundation,](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=DeHWpkl-02YnUCTXT2d6sGoOkIRMzXILuh1cQVM3Vv0Q0D2wkpiCd4mQO1HhElAduhF-zwH53zUaR7yMmSRL47ptfBUh4rfE66Vuze6XNf0=) the[U.S. Space & Rocket Center](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=G44fRCnw6C2EdJdL5bBMcCnMfqRK8K9GMkCMjSlgfrgGWWqq8x6qW6mSERkpP4GJEL-_dYV7AGyqEpu7RCM_htPVTf-BSBOM9mspluz4yFAY-Q0oph_lL6QR90v8keS5) , and the[KID Museum](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=OIGOxvrs5LO0F4Wfu8_lqyTFAEXf8XLNpfSXJ2N97XA0ssQfioMWb5Y4BqAaQp3lKP2aHp5nFbeBagTEcR9j8Q==) .
